description: Source code for the IMediaMetadataRetriever interface implementation in Android, including binder transaction handling, method implementations for setting data sources, retrieving frames, album art, and metadata, as well as scheduling policy hacks.

classes.name: BpMediaMetadataRetriever
classes.description: Binder proxy class for IMediaMetadataRetriever, implementing methods to interact with media metadata retriever service.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the media metadata retriever service.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the data source for media retrieval, either via URL with headers or file descriptor with offset and length.

methods.name: getFrameAtTime
methods.description: Retrieves a video frame at a specified time with options, using binder transaction.

methods.name: extractMetadata
methods.description: Extracts metadata value for a given key code.
